summary: Add shared Git discovery and local change-index components

replay.detail: The index is node-local and rebuildable from explicitly verified Git records; no first-open history scan or replicated replay change.

schema.detail: Adds empty local_git_change_records and local_git_change_latest tables. No user-version bump, claim kind, or binding-contract field.

rules.detail: No stage authority, runtime-lease recovery, signed-evidence policy, landing, or retention behavior.

compatibility.detail: No public CLI or client route yet. Existing builds ignore the additive local index tables.

manual.detail: The components have no configured daemon caller; no operator action or pruning is activated.

recovery.detail: Components retain the last successful inventory after a failed discovery and distinguish exact indexed, sync-needed, missing, conflicting, and offline records. Explicit fetch shares the read budget.
